<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-br">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Vinicius Soares Brandão | Data Analytics & BI</title>

<link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%2064%2064%22%3E%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M18%2C12%20L46%2C12%20L36%2C34%20L28%2C34%20Z%22%20fill%3D%22%23C9A84C%22%20opacity%3D%220.92%22%2F%3E%3Cpath%20d%3D%22M22%2C14%20L42%2C14%20L38%2C26%20L26%2C26%20Z%22%20fill%3D%22%23C9A84C%22%20opacity%3D%220.5%22%2F%3E%3Crect%20x%3D%2230%22%20y%3D%2234%22%20width%3D%224%22%20height%3D%2211%22%20rx%3D%221.5%22%20fill%3D%22%23C9A84C%22%2F%3E%3Crect%20x%3D%2221%22%20y%3D%2245%22%20width%3D%2222%22%20height%3D%224%22%20rx%3D%222%22%20fill%3D%22%23C9A84C%22%2F%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E"/>

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,500;0,600;0,700;1,500&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@300;400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<style>
/* ── RESET & ROOT ── */
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
:root{
  /* Safra navy palette */
  --s-black:   #080C18;
  --s-dark:    #0B1020;
  --s-dark2:   #0E1528;
  --s-dark3:   #131C34;
  --s-cream:   #F0E8D5;
  --s-cream2:  #EAE0CA;
  --s-cream3:  #D8CCB0;
  --s-gold:    #C9A84C;
  --s-gold2:   #B8962E;
  --s-gold3:   #A07828;
  --s-gold4:   #6B5020;
  --s-gold5:   #3A2C10;
  --s-text:    #E4D4A2;
  --s-text2:   #C0A868;
  --s-text3:   #8A7040;
  --s-text-cr: #1C1408;
  --s-text-cr2:#3A2E18;
  --s-text-cr3:#6A5A30;
  /* UI */
  --radius: 2px;
  --transition: .32s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
body{
  background:var(--s-black);
  color:var(--s-text);
  font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
  overflow-x:hidden;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  cursor:none;
}
a,button,[onclick]{cursor:none;}

/* ── CUSTOM CURSOR ── */
#cursor-dot{
  position:fixed;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--s-gold);
  pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  transition:width .2s,height .2s,background .2s,opacity .2s;
  box-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(201,168,76,.8),0 0 20px rgba(201,168,76,.3);
}
#cursor-ring{
  position:fixed;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;
  border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.5);
  pointer-events:none;z-index:9998;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  transition:width .35s ease,height .35s ease,border-color .35s,opacity .3s;
}
body.cursor-hover #cursor-dot{
  width:12px;height:12px;
  background:var(--s-gold);
  box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(201,168,76,1),0 0 36px rgba(201,168,76,.4);
}
body.cursor-hover #cursor-ring{
  width:52px;height:52px;
  border-color:rgba(201,168,76,.8);
}
body.cursor-click #cursor-dot{
  width:6px;height:6px;
  background:#fff;
}
body.cursor-click #cursor-ring{
  width:24px;height:24px;
  border-color:var(--s-gold);
}

/* ── BACKGROUND LAYERS ── */
.bg-gradient{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 10% 5%, rgba(201,168,76,.06) 0%, transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 50% at 90% 90%, rgba(20,40,120,.15) 0%, transparent 50%),
    linear-gradient(160deg, #080C18 0%, #0B1020 100%);
}
.code-rain-dark{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:12;pointer-events:none;opacity:.11;mix-blend-mode:screen;}
.code-rain-dark span{position:absolute;top:-100px;color:#B89030;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;animation:rain-fall linear infinite;}
.code-rain-light{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:12;pointer-events:none;opacity:.06;mix-blend-mode:multiply;}
.code-rain-light span{position:absolute;top:-100px;color:#5A3C10;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;animation:rain-fall linear infinite;}
@keyframes rain-fall{
  0%{transform:translateY(-100px);opacity:0;}
  8%{opacity:1;}
  100%{transform:translateY(110vh);opacity:0;}
}
.noise{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:13;pointer-events:none;opacity:.018;
  background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
  background-size:200px 200px;
}

/* ── NAVIGATION ── */
nav{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:200;
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
  padding:0 56px;height:68px;
  background:rgba(8,12,24,.82);
  backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(1.4);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(1.4);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.08);
}
.nav-logo{
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:600;
  color:var(--s-gold);letter-spacing:3px;
  text-decoration:none;
}
.nav-logo span{color:var(--s-text3);font-weight:400;}
.nav-links{display:flex;gap:36px;align-items:center;}
.nav-links a{
  color:var(--s-text3);text-decoration:none;
  font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:2.5px;text-transform:uppercase;
  font-weight:500;transition:color var(--transition);
  position:relative;padding-bottom:2px;
}
.nav-links a::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:1px;
  background:var(--s-gold);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;
  transition:transform var(--transition);
}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--s-gold);}
.nav-links a:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1);}
.nav-cta{
  background:var(--s-gold);color:var(--s-black)!important;
  padding:8px 20px!important;font-weight:600!important;
  transition:background var(--transition),transform var(--transition)!important;
}
.nav-cta::after{display:none!important;}
.nav-cta:hover{background:var(--s-text)!important;transform:translateY(-1px);}

/* ── SECTIONS ── */
section{
  position:relative;z-index:10;
  min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  justify-content:center;align-items:center;
  padding:120px 24px 96px;
}
section.light{
  background:var(--s-cream);
  color:var(--s-text-cr);
}
section.mid{
  background:var(--s-dark2);
}

/* ── ANIMATIONS ── */
@keyframes fadeUp{
  from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);}
  to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
}
.fade{opacity:0;animation:fadeUp .9s forwards;}
.d1{animation-delay:.15s}.d2{animation-delay:.3s}.d3{animation-delay:.45s}
.d4{animation-delay:.6s}.d5{animation-delay:.75s}.d6{animation-delay:.9s}

.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity .65s ease,transform .65s ease;}
.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none;}

/* ── HERO ── */
#hero{
  min-height:100vh;text-align:center;
  padding-top:140px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 70% at 50% -5%, rgba(201,168,76,.09) 0%, transparent 55%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 40% at 80% 100%, rgba(20,50,150,.12) 0%, transparent 60%),
    var(--s-black);
}
.hero-eyebrow{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  font-size:.65rem;letter-spacing:5px;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--s-gold);font-weight:500;margin-bottom:32px;
}
.hero-eyebrow::before,.hero-eyebrow::after{
  content:'';display:block;width:40px;height:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,var(--s-gold));
}
.hero-eyebrow::after{transform:rotate(180deg);}

.photo-ring{
  width:132px;height:132px;border-radius:50%;
  border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.3);padding:3px;
  margin:0 auto 36px;position:relative;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(201,168,76,.1), 0 0 40px rgba(201,168,76,.08);
}
.photo-ring::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:-8px;border-radius:50%;
  border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.12);
  animation:ring-pulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes ring-pulse{0%,100%{opacity:.4;transform:scale(1);}50%{opacity:.8;transform:scale(1.02);}}
.photo-ring img{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;display:block;}

h1{
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  font-size:clamp(2.4rem,6vw,4.2rem);
  font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;
  color:var(--s-text);line-height:1.1;
  margin-bottom:16px;
}
h1 .gold{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--s-gold) 0%,#E8D080 50%,var(--s-gold2) 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;
}
.hero-role{
  font-size:.8rem;letter-spacing:4px;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--s-text3);font-weight:400;margin-bottom:28px;
}
.hero-divider{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;margin:0 auto 28px;width:fit-content;
}
.hero-divider::before,.hero-divider::after{
  content:'';display:block;width:80px;height:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,rgba(201,168,76,.35),transparent);
}
.hero-divider-gem{color:var(--s-gold);font-size:.65rem;opacity:.7;}

.typing-wrap{
  font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
  font-size:.88rem;color:var(--s-text3);
  min-height:1.4em;margin-bottom:52px;
  letter-spacing:.5px;
}
.typing{
  border-right:1.5px solid var(--s-gold);
  padding-right:2px;white-space:nowrap;display:inline;
}
.typing.blink{animation:cur-blink .8s infinite;}
@keyframes cur-blink{50%{border-color:transparent;}}

.hero-stats{
  display:flex;gap:0;margin:0 auto 48px;
  border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.15);
  max-width:520px;width:100%;
}
.hero-stat{
  flex:1;padding:20px 24px;border-right:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.1);
  text-align:center;transition:background var(--transition);
}
.hero-stat:last-child{border-right:none;}
.hero-stat:hover{background:rgba(201,168,76,.04);}
.hero-stat-label{font-size:.56rem;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--s-text3);margin-bottom:6px;}
.hero-stat-val{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--s-text2);font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;}

.hero-ctas{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:44px;}
.btn{
  padding:11px 28px;font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:3px;
  text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;
  transition:all var(--transition);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;border:none;
}
.btn-primary{
  background:var(--s-gold);color:var(--s-black);
}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--s-text);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(201,168,76,.25);}
.btn-ghost{
  border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.3);color:var(--s-text2);background:transparent;
}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--s-gold);color:var(--s-gold);background:rgba(201,168,76,.06);transform:translateY(-1px);}

.hero-social{display:flex;gap:28px;justify-content:center;align-items:center;}
.hero-social a{
  font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--s-text3);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;
  transition:color var(--transition);
}
.hero-social a:hover{color:var(--s-gold);}
.hero-social-dot{color:rgba(201,168,76,.3);font-size:.4rem;}

/* ── SECTION HEADERS ── */
.sec-wrap{max-width:1100px;width:100%;}
.sec-eyebrow{
  font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:5px;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--s-gold);font-weight:500;margin-bottom:14px;text-align:center;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;
}
.sec-eyebrow::before,.sec-eyebrow::after{
  content:'';display:block;width:50px;height:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,rgba(201,168,76,.4),transparent);
}
.sec-title{
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4vw,2.6rem);
  font-weight:600;text-align:center;margin-bottom:64px;
  letter-spacing:.5px;
}
section.light .sec-title{color:var(--s-text-cr);}
section.light .sec-eyebrow{color:var(--s-gold3);}
section.light .sec-eyebrow::before,section.light .sec-eyebrow::after{
  background:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,rgba(107,80,32,.5),transparent);
}

/* ── SOBRE ── */
#sobre{padding:120px 56px;}
.sobre-inner{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:340px 1fr;gap:80px;
  max-width:960px;width:100%;align-items:center;
}
.sobre-img-wrap{position:relative;}
.sobre-photo{
  width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;overflow:hidden;
  border:1px solid rgba(107,80,32,.3);
  position:relative;
}
.sobre-photo::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 60%,rgba(8,9,11,.6) 100%);
}
.sobre-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;display:block;}
.sobre-photo-accent{
  position:absolute;bottom:-16px;right:-16px;
  width:100px;height:100px;
  border-right:2px solid rgba(201,168,76,.3);
  border-bottom:2px solid rgba(201,168,76,.3);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.sobre-text p{
  font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.9;color:var(--s-text-cr2);
  letter-spacing:.2px;margin-bottom:20px;
}
.sobre-text p:last-child{margin-bottom:0;}
.sobre-text strong{color:var(--s-text-cr);font-weight:600;}
.sobre-highlight{
  margin-top:32px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;
}
.sobre-pill{
  border:1px solid rgba(107,80,32,.25);padding:14px 18px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;
  transition:border-color var(--transition),background var(--transition);
}
.sobre-pill:hover{border-color:rgba(107,80,32,.5);background:rgba(107,80,32,.05);}
.sobre-pill-label{font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--s-text-cr3);}
.sobre-pill-val{font-size:.88rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--s-text-cr);font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;}

/* ── SKILLS ── */
#skills .sec-wrap{max-width:1000px;}
.skills-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px;
  max-width:1000px;width:100%;
}
.skill-card{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);
  border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.1);
  padding:24px 22px;
  transition:all var(--transition);
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.skill-card::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,var(--s-gold),transparent);
  opacity:0;transition:opacity var(--transition);
}
.skill-card:hover{
  border-color:rgba(201,168,76,.28);
  background:rgba(201,168,76,.04);
  transform:translateY(-3px);
}
.skill-card:hover::before{opacity:1;}
.skill-name{
  font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--s-text2);margin-bottom:18px;font-weight:500;
}
.skill-bar-bg{height:1px;background:rgba(201,168,76,.12);position:relative;margin-bottom:10px;}
.skill-bar-fill{
  position:absolute;top:0;left:0;height:100%;
  background:linear-gradient(to right,var(--s-gold4),var(--s-gold));
  transition:width 1.1s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
  box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(201,168,76,.4);
}
.skill-pct{font-size:.58rem;color:var(--s-text3);letter-spacing:2px;text-align:right;}

/* ── PROJECTS ── */
#projetos{background:var(--s-dark2);}
.proj-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  gap:20px;max-width:1100px;width:100%;
}
.proj-card{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.1);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);
  transition:all var(--transition);overflow:hidden;
  position:relative;
}
.proj-card::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(201,168,76,.04) 0%,transparent 60%);
  opacity:0;transition:opacity var(--transition);pointer-events:none;
}
.proj-card:hover{
  border-color:rgba(201,168,76,.3);
  transform:translateY(-6px);
  box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 0 0 1px rgba(201,168,76,.08);
}
.proj-card:hover::after{opacity:1;}
.proj-thumb{
  height:140px;
  background:var(--s-dark3);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.08);
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.proj-thumb::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(201,168,76,.06) 0%,transparent 70%);
}
.proj-thumb-icon{width:40px;height:40px;opacity:.6;}
.proj-thumb-icon svg{width:100%;height:100%;}
.proj-thumb-label{
  position:absolute;bottom:12px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;
  font-size:.56rem;letter-spacing:2.5px;color:var(--s-text3);text-transform:uppercase;
}
.proj-body{padding:22px 20px;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
.proj-tag{
  font-size:.55rem;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--s-gold3);
  text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:10px;font-weight:500;
}
.proj-name{
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--s-text);margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.4;
}
.proj-desc{font-size:.74rem;color:var(--s-text3);line-height:1.85;letter-spacing:.2px;flex:1;}
.proj-stack{margin-top:16px;display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.tag{
  font-size:.53rem;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--s-text3);border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.15);
  padding:3px 9px;background:rgba(201,168,76,.04);
}
.proj-links{margin-top:16px;display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.proj-link{
  font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--s-gold3);text-decoration:none;
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;
  transition:color var(--transition);font-weight:500;
}
.proj-link:hover{color:var(--s-gold);}
.proj-link-arrow{transition:transform var(--transition);}
.proj-link:hover .proj-link-arrow{transform:translateX(3px);}

/* ── CERTIFICATIONS ── */
#certificacoes{}
.cert-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
  gap:18px;max-width:1100px;width:100%;
}
.cert-card{
  border:1px solid rgba(107,80,32,.2);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.3);
  padding:26px 22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;
  transition:all var(--transition);position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.cert-card::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:3px;height:0;
  background:var(--s-gold);transition:height .5s ease;
}
.cert-card:hover{
  border-color:rgba(107,80,32,.4);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.5);
  transform:translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(58,44,16,.15);
}
.cert-card:hover::before{height:100%;}
.cert-card.em-breve{opacity:.55;pointer-events:none;}
.cert-card.em-breve::before{display:none;}
.cert-icon{width:26px;height:26px;opacity:.7;}
.cert-icon svg{width:100%;height:100%;}
.cert-school{
  font-size:.54rem;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--s-text-cr3);font-weight:500;
}
.cert-name{
  font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;
  font-size:.95rem;color:var(--s-text-cr);line-height:1.4;
}
.cert-meta{
  font-size:.6rem;color:var(--s-text-cr3);letter-spacing:.5px;
  display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.cert-badge{
  display:inline-block;font-size:.5rem;letter-spacing:2px;
  text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 10px;
  border:1px solid rgba(107,80,32,.3);color:var(--s-text-cr3);
}
.cert-badge.concluido{
  border-color:var(--s-gold3);color:var(--s-gold3);
  background:rgba(107,80,32,.08);
}
.cert-badge.andamento{
  border-color:rgba(107,80,32,.2);color:var(--s-text-cr3);
}
.cert-actions{margin-top:auto;display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.cert-link{
  font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--s-gold3);text-decoration:none;
  border:none;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;
  transition:color var(--transition),border-color var(--transition);
  cursor:pointer;background:none;
  font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;padding:0;font-weight:500;
}
.cert-link:hover{color:var(--s-gold2);border-bottom-color:var(--s-gold3);}

/* ── PDF MODAL ── */
#pdf-modal{
  display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:999;
  background:rgba(8,9,11,.95);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;
}
.pdf-modal-controls{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;}
.pdf-modal-btn{
  font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:.6rem;letter-spacing:2.5px;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--s-text2);text-decoration:none;
  border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.2);padding:9px 20px;
  transition:all var(--transition);background:none;cursor:pointer;font-weight:500;
}
.pdf-modal-btn:hover{border-color:var(--s-gold);color:var(--s-gold);background:rgba(201,168,76,.06);}
#pdf-frame{width:min(860px,94vw);height:80vh;border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.15);}

/* ── CONTACT ── */
#contato{background:var(--s-black);}
.contato-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
  gap:16px;max-width:900px;width:100%;
}
.contato-item{
  border:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.12);
  padding:28px 24px;text-decoration:none;
  transition:all var(--transition);display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:rgba(255,255,255,.015);
}
.contato-item::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,var(--s-gold),transparent);
  opacity:0;transition:opacity var(--transition);
}
.contato-item:hover{
  border-color:rgba(201,168,76,.3);background:rgba(201,168,76,.04);
  transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
}
.contato-item:hover::before{opacity:1;}
.contato-icon{font-size:1.2rem;opacity:.7;color:var(--s-gold);}
.contato-item-label{
  font-size:.56rem;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--s-text3);font-weight:500;
}
.contato-item-val{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--s-text2);letter-spacing:.5px;text-align:center;}

/* ── FOOTER ── */
footer{
  position:relative;z-index:10;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.08);
  padding:28px 56px;
  display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
  background:var(--s-black);
}
.footer-copy{font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--s-text3);text-transform:uppercase;}
.footer-tagline{font-size:.58rem;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--s-gold4);font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;}

/* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
@media(max-width:900px){
  nav{padding:0 24px;}
  .nav-links{gap:18px;}
  .nav-links a{font-size:.65rem;}
  .sobre-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:48px;}
  .sobre-img-wrap{max-width:300px;margin:0 auto;}
  .skills-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
  .proj-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .cert-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .contato-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
  footer{flex-direction:column;gap:10px;text-align:center;}
}
@media(max-width:600px){
  nav{padding:0 16px;height:60px;}
  .nav-links{gap:12px;}
  .nav-links a:not(.nav-cta){display:none;}
  h1{font-size:2rem;}
  .hero-stats{flex-direction:column;}
  .hero-stat{border-right:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.1);}
  .sobre-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .skills-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  .proj-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .cert-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .contato-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
  section{padding:100px 20px 80px;}
  #sobre{padding:100px 20px 80px;}
}
</style>
</head>

<script>
/* ── CODE RAIN (dual layer: dark + light sections) ── */
const rainDark=document.querySelector(".code-rain-dark");
const rainLight=document.querySelector(".code-rain-light");
const drops=["import pandas as pd","df.groupby('região')","SELECT * FROM dados","plt.show()","def analyze(df):","return df.describe()","df.dropna()","fig, ax = plt.subplots()","WHERE receita > 0","df['kpi'].mean()","JOIN vendas ON id","model.fit(X_train)","df.to_csv('output')","print(df.head())","GROUP BY mes","df.corr().round(2)","sns.heatmap(corr)","ORDER BY data DESC","df.merge(left,right)","ax.set_xlabel('Data')","X_train, X_test = split"];
function makeSpan(){
  const text=drops[Math.floor(Math.random()*drops.length)];
  const left=Math.random()*100;
  const dur=Math.random()*7+6;
  const fs=Math.random()>.5?'10px':'12px';
  return {text,left,dur,fs};
}
function dropDark(){const {text,left,dur,fs}=makeSpan();const s=document.createElement("span");s.innerText=text;s.style.cssText=`left:${left}vw;animation-duration:${dur}s;font-size:${fs}`;rainDark.appendChild(s);setTimeout(()=>s.remove(),14000);}
function dropLight(){const {text,left,dur,fs}=makeSpan();const s=document.createElement("span");s.innerText=text;s.style.cssText=`left:${left}vw;animation-duration:${dur+1}s;font-size:${fs}`;rainLight.appendChild(s);setTimeout(()=>s.remove(),15000);}
setInterval(dropDark,160);
setInterval(dropLight,200);

/* ── AUDIO ENGINE ── */
let ctx=null;
function getCtx(){
  if(!ctx) ctx=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
  if(ctx.state==='suspended') ctx.resume();
  return ctx;
}
['click','touchstart','keydown'].forEach(ev=>document.addEventListener(ev,()=>getCtx(),{once:true}));


function playHover(){
  const c=getCtx();if(!c)return;
  const now=c.currentTime,sr=c.sampleRate;
  const n=c.createBuffer(1,Math.floor(sr*.003),sr);
  const d=n.getChannelData(0);
  for(let i=0;i<d.length;i++) d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*Math.pow(1-i/d.length,2)*.8;
  const s=c.createBufferSource();s.buffer=n;
  const f=c.createBiquadFilter();f.type='highpass';f.frequency.value=4500;
  const g=c.createGain();g.gain.setValueAtTime(.25,now);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,now+.005);
  s.connect(f);f.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);s.start(now);
}

/* ── TYPEWRITER (cycling phrases from CV) ── */
const tw=document.getElementById('typewriter');
const phrases=[
  "Python · SQL · Power BI · Analista de Dados Jr.",
  "Transformando dados brutos em decisões de negócio.",
  "ETL, dashboards e storytelling com dados.",
  "Do setor administrativo para Data Analytics & BI.",
  "Análise exploratória com Pandas, NumPy e Seaborn.",
  "Criando dashboards estratégicos com Power BI.",
  "Consultas SQL — joins, views, procedures e ETL.",
  "Automação de processos com Python e n8n.",
  "Buscando minha primeira oportunidade em BI Jr.",
  "São Paulo, SP · Disponibilidade imediata.",
];
let phraseIdx=0;
function startTypewriter(){
  tw.classList.remove('blink');
  let i=0;
  const phrase=phrases[phraseIdx];
  function typeChar(){
    if(i<phrase.length){
      tw.textContent=phrase.slice(0,i+1);
      const delay=52+Math.random()*48+(phrase[i]===' '?25:0)+(phrase[i]==='.'?100:0)+(phrase[i]==='·'?80:0);
      i++;setTimeout(typeChar,delay);
    } else {
      tw.classList.add('blink');
      setTimeout(erasePhrase, 2600);
    }
  }
  function erasePhrase(){
    tw.classList.remove('blink');
    let j=phrase.length;
    function eraseChar(){
      if(j>0){tw.textContent=phrase.slice(0,j-1);j--;setTimeout(eraseChar,28);}
      else{phraseIdx=(phraseIdx+1)%phrases.length;setTimeout(startTypewriter,400);}
    }
    eraseChar();
  }
  setTimeout(typeChar, phraseIdx===0?1400:200);
}
setTimeout(startTypewriter,1600);

/* ── HOVER SOUNDS ── */
['.hero-stat','.btn','.hero-social a','.nav-links a','.skill-card','.proj-card','.proj-link','.contato-item','.cert-card:not(.em-breve)','.cert-link'].forEach(sel=>{
  document.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('mouseenter',playHover));
});

/* ── SCROLL REVEAL ── */
const obs=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
  entries.forEach(e=>{
    if(e.isIntersecting){
      e.target.classList.add('visible');
      e.target.querySelectorAll('.skill-bar-fill[data-w]').forEach(b=>{b.style.width=b.dataset.w;});
    }
  });
},{threshold:.12});
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el=>obs.observe(el));

/* ── PDF DATA ── */
const pdfData = {
  'cert-python': 'data:application/pdf;base64,'
};

function openPdf(key){
  const modal=document.getElementById('pdf-modal');
  const frame=document.getElementById('pdf-frame');
  const dl=document.getElementById('pdf-download');
  frame.src=pdfData[key];dl.href=pdfData[key];dl.download=key+'.pdf';
  modal.style.display='flex';document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
}
function closePdf(){
  document.getElementById('pdf-frame').src='';
  document.getElementById('pdf-modal').style.display='none';
  document.body.style.overflow='';
}
document.getElementById('pdf-modal').addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===this)closePdf();});

/* ── CUSTOM GOLDEN CURSOR ── */
const dot=document.getElementById('cursor-dot');
const ring=document.getElementById('cursor-ring');
let mx=0,my=0,rx=0,ry=0;
document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{
  mx=e.clientX;my=e.clientY;
  dot.style.left=mx+'px';dot.style.top=my+'px';
});
(function animRing(){
  rx+=(mx-rx)*.12;ry+=(my-ry)*.12;
  ring.style.left=rx+'px';ring.style.top=ry+'px';
  requestAnimationFrame(animRing);
})();
const hoverEls='a,button,[onclick],.skill-card,.proj-card,.contato-item,.cert-card,.hero-stat,.nav-links a';
document.querySelectorAll(hoverEls).forEach(el=>{
  el.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>document.body.classList.add('cursor-hover'));
  el.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>document.body.classList.remove('cursor-hover'));
});
document.addEventListener('mousedown',()=>document.body.classList.add('cursor-click'));
document.addEventListener('mouseup',()=>document.body.classList.remove('cursor-click'));
document.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>{dot.style.opacity='0';ring.style.opacity='0';});
document.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>{dot.style.opacity='1';ring.style.opacity='1';});
</script>
</body>
</html>
